args.title: Fix export filenames showing next day's date in some time zones
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The function formatExportFilename formats export filenames using at.toISOString().slice(0, 10), which gives the date in UTC. Change it to use the local date to avoid exporting filenames with a next day's date in late hours for some time zones.

args.title: Fix parsing to ensure amounts are exact integers without floating-point errors
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Adjust the parsing logic in src/ingest/parser.ts to maintain amounts as exact integers without floating-point conversion. This avoids any floating-point rounding or precision errors at the parsing stage, consistent with the IncomingTransaction type defined in src/types.ts that uses integer minor units.
